# The Edible Codex

> A digital cookbook by Chef Ahmet Salameh: 361 recipes across 386 pages (261 chef recipes plus 100 viral dishes), each with its own photograph, exact measurements, step-by-step method and a chef's note. The site is bilingual: Arabic at the root, English under /en/. It publishes 58 complete recipes from the book for free, short technique videos, and a free guide to five colour sauces.

## Products

- [The Edible Codex — the complete book ($14.99)](https://ediblecodex.com/en/shop/the-edible-codex/): 361 recipes, instant digital download, 30-day refund.
- [The Five Signature Sauces (free)](https://ediblecodex.com/en/shop/the-five-sauces/): beetroot, turmeric, herb, roasted pepper and reduced balsamic sauces, with ratios in grams.

## Free recipes

- [All free recipes](https://ediblecodex.com/en/recipes/): complete recipes from the book with ingredients, method and the chef's note.
- [الوصفات المجانية بالعربية](https://ediblecodex.com/recipes/): the same recipes in Arabic.
